items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: it was Charlie Christen on the trombone and, uh, uh, myself... I trooped on that show for about a year. ... that's, that's, uh, Paul English Players.

ctx.x: And, uh, it was Charlie Christen on the trombone and, uh, uh, myself, Willie Guitars played bass and lived on Music Street. He used to have a little trap, trap, door, door on the bass, you know, and we'd always wonder because he used to drink, you know, plenty. So, we'd always wonder, say, well, how the devil could he, he'd get drunk that quick? See? So, he'd carry his whiskey and a little medicine bottle, see, and that little trap door in them days in the bass. So, he'd open up the trap door and pull a bottle…
How big a band would you have in that band?
